card.name: Ending of cynomolgus before monkeys
card.fires_on: The final piece "us" of the species name cynomolgus, right before the word monkeys, in animal reproduction or toxicity study text. It also fires weakly on a few other word-ending pieces.

modes.label: cynomolgus ending
modes.description: The "us" that completes cynomolg(us) before monkeys in animal study passages.
modes.example: In an animal reproduction study, intravenous administration of cetuximab once weekly to pregnant cynomolg<<us>> monkeys during the period of organogenesis resulted

modes.label: Stray word pieces
modes.description: Occasional word-internal pieces in drug names or foreign-language text.

card.plain: It marks the end of the word cynomolgus in animal study descriptions, just before the word monkeys.
